jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Technical, Amazon Business Analytics
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about building innovative, customer facing analytics products that help businesses make smarter purchasing decisions? Do you enjoy solving complex customer problems at scale using data, analytics, and artificial intelligence? Are you excited about shaping how organizations of all sizes understand, manage, and optimize their business spending?  
  
Amazon Business is transforming how businesses, governments, and organizations purchase products and manage procurement operations. Serving millions of business customers worldwide, Amazon Business combines the selection, convenience, and value of Amazon with capabilities tailored to the unique needs of business customers.  
  
Amazon Business Analytics (ABA) plays a critical role in this transformation by building a suite of customer facing analytics products that help organizations turn purchasing data into actionable insights. Our customers range from small and medium businesses to large enterprises and public sector organizations. Our products empower procurement leaders, finance teams, and business administrators to understand organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, monitor purchasing behavior, and make informed business decisions.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Technical (PMT) to help shape and deliver the next generation of Amazon Business Analytics experiences. In this role, you will drive product strategy and execution across our customer facing analytics portfolio, spanning spend visibility, self service reporting, intelligent insights, and AI powered conversational analytics. You will build intuitive and scalable products for the full range of business customers, from those seeking simple, out of the box spending insights to large enterprises requiring sophisticated analytics across complex organizational structures.  
  
You will have the opportunity to reimagine how business customers interact with their purchasing data, moving beyond traditional dashboards and reports toward intelligent, proactive, and conversational experiences. You will use advances in generative AI, large language models, and modern data technologies to make analytics more accessible, personalized, and actionable for customers worldwide.  
  
This is a highly visible role that requires strong customer obsession, technical judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence and deliver across multiple engineering and business organizations. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, dives deep into customer and technical challenges, and has a demonstrated track record of building and scaling customer facing technology products.  
  
We are open to hiring candidates to work from the following locations: Hyderabad, IND | Bangalore, IND  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As the PMT for ABA, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for customer facing analytics capabilities across Amazon Business. You will develop a deep understanding of how small businesses, large enterprises, procurement professionals, and finance teams use purchasing data, and turn those needs into intuitive, scalable, and differentiated product experiences.  
  
You will lead the development of intelligent analytics experiences, including conversational interfaces, natural language querying, proactive insights, and AI powered capabilities. You will also build products that help customers analyze organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, and improve procurement outcomes. You will balance ease of use for smaller businesses with the depth that large enterprises require, and develop capabilities that serve customers across multiple geographies.  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, applied science, UX, and data teams to define product requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and deliver scalable, reliable analytics solutions. You will define success metrics and use customer feedback, experimentation, and data to keep improving outcomes. Finally, you will collaborate with senior leaders across Amazon Business to align priorities and drive decisions.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in an operational environment developing, fast-prototyping, piloting and launching analytic products

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Product/Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**

The Product/Project Manager drives the program from MVP to GA. You own the backlog and plan, keep a cross-functional technical team aligned on milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and provide clear delivery reporting to ComTek-side stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product**

* **Backlog:** Own the product backlog and prioritise by customer value, risk and GA scope using the story map and technical dependency analysis with the Tech Architect.

* **GA definition:** Define the GA scope, exit criteria and readiness checklist (security, performance, billing, migration, support).

* **Beta:** Run the beta programme and feedback loop with the Business Analyst.

**Delivery**

* **Cadence:** Run sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives; track velocity and DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore).

* **Plan:** Maintain milestones and the critical path across ingestion, AI/ML, billing, identity, security and migration workstreams; manage cross-team dependencies and environment/GPU capacity needs.

* **Risk:** Maintain RAID log; escalate and mitigate technical and schedule risks with workstream leads.

**Stakeholders and Migration**

* **Reporting:** Provide weekly status, burn-up, risk and budget reports to ComTek-side stakeholders.

* **Migration:** Coordinate MVP customer migration planning, communications, cutover windows and support readiness.

* **Change control:** Manage scope changes and decision records with the Tech Architect.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 7+ years in product or project management with SaaS experience.

* Agile delivery at scale; Jira or similar.

* Experience managing technically complex programmes involving cloud, data and AI.

* Strong stakeholder communication and reporting.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, billing or data/AI products.

* Customer migration programmes.

* PMP, CSM, SAFe or similar certification.

**Key Deliverables**

* Program plan, roadmap and milestone tracker.

* Weekly delivery reports; RAID log.

* GA readiness checklist and cutover plan.

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business or equivalent; MBA a plus.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,600,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is looking for a talented Software Development Engineer (SDE) to build innovative solutions that drive deeper Customer Experience (CX) insights and faster CX improvements across Amazon.  
  
As an SDE, you will contribute to a variety of high-impact initiatives that empower our partners. These initiatives include generating data-driven insights through personalized business applications and data infrastructure enhancements, creating seamless workflow experiences by improving our core platform and developing streamlined stakeholder interactions, and cultivating compliance-first solutions that implement robust access controls and raise the bar on security and data governance.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and participate in the full development life-cycle, including design, development, and implementation of code, tools, and scripts for one or more systems.
* Engage in full-stack development, designing and building scalable, robust web applications and services that enhance the overall customer experience.
* Develop and integrate Generative AI (GenAI) solutions to create intelligent, personalized customer interactions and automate complex processes.
* Innovate and improve processes to enhance key business outputs and drive continuous improvement.
* Work closely with program managers, designers, and other stakeholders to rapidly deliver high-quality, customer-centric solutions.
* Leverage your strong coding skills, technical depth, and passion for solving complex problems.

  
About the team  
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings – for almost every business at Amazon – for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, employees, investors, streamers, gamers).  
  
Our approach is based on determining the customer need, along with problem solving, and we work backwards from there. We use technical and non-technical approaches and stay aware of industry and business trends. We are a global team, made up of a diverse set of profiles, skills, and backgrounds – including: Product Managers, Software Developers, Computer Vision experts, Solutions Architects, Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Business Analysts, Risk Managers, and more.

------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

* Consistently maintain a growth mindset

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* 5+ years of technical product or business analysis experience
* 3+ years of experience with agile development methodology

* Fluent in AHA!, Rally, GitHub
* Demonstrated solid written & verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated high attention to detail, including the ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
* Demonstrated ability to think strategically and execute methodically
* Demonstrated ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, schedule tradeoffs, and opportunistic new ideas with technical and non-technical employees

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with prepaid/debit instruments, network rules (e.g., Visa/Mastercard), or benefit administration platforms
* Demonstrated to be innovative, strategic thinker with solution-focused problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated growth mindset with the ability to work collaboratively and influence others in adopting change
* Demonstrated to be comfortable presenting to large audiences, both technical and non-technical

Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian.com/careers) to understand why.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As Senior Product Manager, you will lead product strategy and delivery across the Fraud and ID Agent Initiative, from the current MVP through the roadmap toward a scalable, production-ready capability. You will connect client and analyst needs with fraud expertise, data science, engineering, platform, legal, compliance, and AI governance partners.

* **Set product direction.** Define the product vision, and measurable outcomes for fraud and identity capabilities, balancing the near-term pilot with a reusable longer-term product.

* **Build the next-phase roadmap.** Use evidence from the pilot to prioritize production readiness, broader data coverage, a purpose-built analyst experience, and future client or regional expansion.

We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. **Role Summary:**

Experian's Digital Identity team is seeking a Product Manager II to reimagine how we run one of the most critical systems in consumer finance: the identity layer that helps tens of millions of people prove who they are, access their accounts, and stay protected from fraud. This is a chance to help define what modern identity operations look like — and to build it from the ground up.

As Product Manager II, you will shape and own the product strategy for an operations platform that helps our teams detect issues as they emerge, understand root cause quickly, and resolve problems with less manual effort. You'll bring modern tooling and automation to make our identity systems more observable, more, and easier to run. Working across our teams you'll have unusual breadth, high visibility, and the opportunity to grow a capability that will scale well beyond its starting point.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Define the vision and roadmap for an operations platform that gives Digital Identity a real-time, end-to-end understanding of how our consumer journeys, systems, and partner integrations are performing.
* Shorten the path from detecting an issue to resolving it by improving how teams monitor, investigate, and respond across the identity ecosystem.
* Identify high-friction manual workflows across teams and lead their transformation into streamlined, automated processes that free people to focus on higher-value work.
* Bring consistency to how we monitor and evaluate third-party identity and fraud partners, so performance shifts are detected once, shared broadly, and acted on quickly.
* Partner closely with engineering, data science, analytics, and pod leaders to turn ambiguous operational challenges into well-defined problems, clear requirements, and measurable outcomes.
* Evaluate emerging tools and techniques — including AI where it adds real value — through focused proofs of concept, and scale the approaches that prove their worth.
* Look across pods to spot recurring patterns and build reusable capabilities that make every team faster, rather than solving the same problem in isolation.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For:**

* 10+ years of experience in which 3+ years of product management or related experience building software products.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business/Marketing, or a technical field.
* Turn complex, cross-team problems into a structured, prioritized plan and see it through to delivery.
* Comfort influencing across multiple teams and stakeholders without direct authority.
* And a metrics-driven approach to decision-making.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, platform, or internal tooling products.

* Background in identity, authentication, fraud, or financial services.
* You will directly report to Director.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers

Our platforms optimize operations across marine and rail terminals, yard management, transportation management, and fleet maintenance, enabling greater efficiency, safety, and visibility.

  

Our Yard Management System (YMS) helps companies manage the movement of trailers, containers, drivers, and other assets within their facilities. By connecting yard operations, transportation processes, automation, and real-time visibility, Kaleris

enables customers to improve yard efficiency, reduce manual work, and make better operational decisions.

  

**Role Overview**

  

We are seeking a Product Manager Intern to join our Product Management team working on our Yard Management System. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in building enterprise software used by organizations across the global

supply chain.

  

As a Product Manager Intern, you will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, UX, QA, and other cross-functional teams to understand customer problems, analyze workflows, define product requirements, and support the delivery of new product

capabilities.

The ideal candidate is curious about how software products are built, enjoys solving problems, has strong analytical and communication skills, and is interested in logistics, supply chain, and enterprise technology.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with Product Managers to understand customer needs, business problems, and operational workflows.
* Conduct research and analysis to identify opportunities for improving the Yard Management System.
* Help translate business and customer requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with Engineering and QA teams during feature development, refinement, testing, and release activities.
* Participate in product discovery sessions, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Analyze product usage, operational data, customer feedback, and support issues to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Create product documentation, workflow diagrams, process flows, release notes, and other product artifacts.
* Support competitive research and industry analysis related to yard management, logistics, transportation, and supply chain technology.

* Work with cross-functional teams to identify gaps in existing workflows and recommend product improvements.
* Support customer demos, internal product reviews, and release readiness activities.
* Learn and apply product management practices in an enterprise software environment.

* Currently pursuing a bachelors or masters degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand complex workflows and break problems into clear, actionable requirements.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. **4. Analytics Transformation & AI Innovation**

* Advance Finance reporting capabilities from traditional descriptive analytics toward proactive, insight-driven, and AI-enabled analytics.
* Embed Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) principles into the day-to-day use of AI and LLM technologies across Finance, ensuring responsible adoption, appropriate controls, and compliance with SOX requirements and sensitive financial data protection policies.
* Leverage Snowflake, Tableau, AI, and advanced analytical techniques to develop innovative reporting solutions and improve data exploration.
* Support the development of reusable analytical datasets, dashboards, and self-service reporting capabilities.
Explore emerging technologies and AI-driven automation opportunities to improve productivity, scalability, and decision-making.

* 8+ years of experience in Finance data management, data analytics, or data stewardship, understanding of accounting processes and financial reporting.
* 4+ years of experience in data governance, risk management, SOX compliance, audit readiness, business process improvement, and related areas.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing compliance team, providing clear direction, accountability, coaching, and career development while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Overview**

The Junior AI Platform Engineer supports the development and operation of platforms used to deploy, integrate, scale, secure, and monitor AI and machine learning solutions. The role combines software engineering, backend development, cloud computing, containerization, DevOps, and AI platform fundamentals.

* Basic familiarity with Linux command-line operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.

**Overview**

Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions-Core (MCAPS) accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.

Within MCAPS - Core, the Customer Service & Support (CSS) organization builds trust and confidence for every person and organization through delivering a seamless support experience. In CSS, we are powered by Microsoft’s AI technology to help consumers, businesses, partners, and more, resolve their issues quickly and securely, helping prevent future problems from occurring and achieving more from their Microsoft investment.

In the Customer Service & Support (CSS) team we are looking for people with a passion for delivering customer success. As a Technical Support Engineer, you will own, troubleshoot, and solve customers’ technical issues. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, hone your problem-solving, collaboration and research skills, and develop your technical proficiency.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Escalation Ownership and Resolution

Own complex, high-impact CSP and Partner Center escalations from initial assessment through mitigation, resolution, and closure.

Establish a clear problem statement, business impact, scope, timeline, and technical investigation plan.

Perform deep troubleshooting across Partner Center, identity and access, tenant and partner relationships, subscriptions, licensing, billing, commerce transactions, APIs, service integrations, and dependent cloud services.

Analyze logs, telemetry, error patterns, service behavior, and case history to isolate root cause and identify the most effective recovery path.

Develop and validate mitigations, workarounds, and recovery guidance while managing technical risk and customer impact.

Maintain rigorous case documentation, including investigation findings, decisions, owners, dependencies, risks, and next steps.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

Lead technical collaboration across frontline support, engineering, operations, incident management, and product teams.

Engage the right resources, clarify ownership, and remove blockers to accelerate resolution.

Translate complex technical findings into clear, audience-appropriate updates for partners, customers, support leaders, and engineering stakeholders.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Product Management**
**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**
**About The Role**
Deloitte is looking for a hands-on product manager to own a product end-to-end within Deloitte Consulting Products. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the day-to-day of a product built for the US market—running discovery, shaping the roadmap, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to ship value clients actually use.
  
  
This is a builder's role at its core. You're the strongest product craftsperson on your product: closest to the user, closest to the backlog, and accountable for the outcomes it delivers. You'll work with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders to stay grounded in the market you're building for.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for your product, turning priorities into a clear plan of what to build next
* Make the day-to-day prioritization and trade-off calls, sequencing work by value, effort, and readiness
* Define and track the metrics that show it's working: adoption, engagement, retention, impact
* Know when something isn't working—flag it early and make the case to change course or stop

**Discover & Validate**

* Run discovery to understand your users and the problems worth solving, partnering with US product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders
* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and rapid validation before building at scale
* Use both generative and evaluative research to answer “are we building the right thing?” and “are we building it right?”

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and products from concept through define, shape, build, and scale
* Own the product backlog: write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and keep it groomed and prioritized
* Work as one team with engineering and UX—sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving
* Own launch, adoption, and iteration; instrument the product and act on what the data shows
* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery to move faster without cutting corners

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients—join demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations, and turn what you hear into the roadmap
* Support go-to-market with product marketing, sales, and account teams: positioning, demos, and enablement
* Stay fluent in the US market realities that shape your product: data privacy, SaaS vs. on-prem

**Work Across the Network**

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align your product with delivery capacity and real client needs, and be the go-to for questions on your product
* Mentor and lift the product managers and associates around you, modeling strong product craft

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to a Senior Manager / AVP of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering and UX, partners with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and collaborates with GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 6+ years in product management or product ownership, including owning a product end-to-end
* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, with measurable outcomes
* Strong hands-on product craft: backlog, user stories and acceptance criteria, and working day to day with engineering and design in an agile setup
* Fluent in discovery and validation—user research, hypotheses, prototypes—not just delivery
* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.
  
  
**Job Description**
Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:
  
  

* Owning the roadmap. Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* Working with customers. Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field
* Driving delivery. Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* Working with Requirements Management tools: These tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* Connecting to the platform. Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.
* Using AI. Apply AI to speed up damage triage, image capture workflows, and data quality checks. Use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster.
* Supporting sales and delivery. Join customer calls, write positioning material, and help account teams win and deliver deals with Southern Company, PPL, and the accounts that follow them.
* Guiding customers off legacy. Help utilities move from FieldSmart, AEMS, and other legacy tools onto the modern GridOS Field platform.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Product management or other Management experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in utilities, energy, telecom, or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of utility field operations, outage restoration, or ADMS/DMS/OMS and other Field Maintenance Flows. If you have not lived it, you have shipped software to people who have.
* A track record of running more than one program at a time with a clear, data-driven approach.
* Comfort with AI tools in your own product workflow.
* Strong writing and communication. You can turn a messy customer conversation into a clear requirement, a crisp roadmap update, or a one-page memo.
* Commercial judgment. You can connect a product decision to a revenue, cost, or customer outcome.
* A Lean and Agile mindset. You adjust quickly when priorities shift, and you close things out.

Education Requirements
  
  
**For US candidates:**
A Master's degree, or a High School Diploma/GED with at least six years of professional experience.
  
  
**For non-US candidates:**
A Master's equivalent, or a High School Diploma with relevant professional experience.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
You will work on software that utilities depend on during their most challenging times to maintain infrastructure stability while experiencing exponential growth in demand. restoring service.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Real impact. Providing Value to Large Tier 1 and Tier2 Utility and Telco companies, with a clear runway to grow.
* Modern stack. Single-tenant SaaS on hyperscaler infrastructure, with AI built in through the Prism platform.
* Direct customer contact. You talk to the people using the product, not just the people buying it.
* Growth. GridOS Field is scaling. Strong PMs move up.

Success in This Role
  
  
You will know you are succeeding when the Adoption rate of GridOS Field increasing and becomes a key part of both our existing customer base and prospects.
  
  
Working Arrangement
  
  
Permanent, fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and GE Vernova offices.
  
  
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from everyone who meets the criteria and is interested in the future of the grid.
  
  
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
No

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in test automation frameworks, API testing, CI/CD integration, and Agile methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze business and functional requirements and prepare test scenarios and test cases.

* Develop reusable automation utilities and libraries.
* Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to ensure quality deliverables.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.

* Experience in **TestNG/JUnit** frameworks.

* Experience in **BDD frameworks** such as **Cucumber**.
* Knowledge of **SQL** and database testing.
* Experience with **Git, Maven, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions**.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with **Playwright** or **Cypress**.
* Experience in cloud platforms such as **Azure** or **AWS**.

Qualifications

* Experience working in enterprise applications.
* Exposure to Banking, Retail, Healthcare, or E-commerce domains.

jobs.company: DOWC Technologies pvt ltd - Fortis India
jobs.description:
**Department:** Product & Implementation

**Experience:** 2–5 years (flexible for candidates with relevant skills)

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Business Analyst to support the

successful adoption and ongoing use of our enterprise software platform.

This role will primarily focus on product training, user onboarding, functional support, and

issue resolution following the software launch. The ideal candidate should be comfortable

understanding complex software workflows, simplifying them for different audiences, and

helping users confidently navigate the platform.

The individual will work closely with the Product, Implementation, Development, and

Business teams to ensure a seamless transition from implementation to ongoing product

usage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Training & User Enablement**

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the software's modules, features,

workflows, and business processes.

* Conduct virtual and in-person product training sessions for internal teams, clients,

and other stakeholders.

* Simplify complex product functionality and business workflows into easy-to understand training content.

* Create and maintain user guides, training presentations, FAQs, walkthroughs, and

other learning resources.

* Deliver role-based training tailored to different user groups and their responsibilities

within the software.

* Conduct refresher sessions and communicate new features, enhancements, and

workflow changes to existing users.

* Collect training feedback and continuously improve training effectiveness.

**2. Post-Launch Functional Support**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for functional queries and user assistance

following software implementation.

* Assist users in navigating the platform, understanding workflows, and resolving day to-day functional challenges.

* Investigate reported issues, reproduce errors, and distinguish between user errors,

configuration issues, and potential product defects.

**About the job**

**Job Title: Business Analyst — Conga CPQ / CLM (Quote-to-Cash)**

**Experience:**
5 - 9 Years

**Employment Type:**
Permanent | Full-Time

**Shift & Hours:**
Regular Shift

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**About the Company**

* Forsys Inc. is a systems integrator focused on Lead-to-Revenue transformation, helping global enterprises design and implement the processes and platforms behind quoting, contracting, ordering and billing. Our Solutions capability brings together business architects, functional consultants and engineers who work shoulder-to-shoulder with client process owners. We deliver across industries — technology, manufacturing, life sciences, communications and financial services — on programs that touch how our clients sell and recognise revenue. Our Hyderabad delivery centre is a core part of that engine, partnering daily with onshore architects and client stakeholders.

**Role Overview**

* As a Business Analyst within our Business Architecture team, you will sit between client process owners and the build team on Conga Quote-to-Cash programs delivered on Salesforce. You will facilitate discovery, map current and future-state processes, and convert them into user stories, configuration definitions and test scenarios that developers and admins can act on without guesswork. You will partner closely with the Solution Architect to pressure-test design decisions and keep scope, traceability and change impact visible. This role is hands-on: you are expected to configure in Conga, not just document what others will build.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate requirement and process workshops with client stakeholders covering quoting, pricing, discounting, approvals, agreements, orders, amendments and renewals; document current-state and future-state process flows in Visio or Lucidchart.
* Write clear, implementable user stories with acceptance criteria, maintain the product backlog and keep a requirements traceability matrix current from discovery through sign-off.
* Produce fit-gap analyses against out-of-the-box Conga CPQ and CLM capability, and support the Solution Architect with options, trade-offs and recommendations for design decisions.
* Define and configure Conga CPQ product catalogue structures, bundles and options, price lists, price rules and matrices, constraint rules and approval processes.
* Define and configure Conga CLM agreement types, templates, clause libraries, document generation and approval routing, including amendment and renewal handling.
* Support data migration workstreams by defining mapping rules and validation criteria for products, price lists, agreements, assets and historical contract data.

**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Position Overview and Objective**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to oversee our network appliance and fleet management infrastructure.

The Senior Product Manager: Network Appliance will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the applications and capabilities we deploy and support on our network appliance platform as well as the infrastructure required to manage our fleet at scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for the applications and capabilities deployed and supported on the platform.

* Drive Datapath capabilities, including IDS, syslog ingestion & pre-parsing, network ML.

* Own on premises features that bridge Arctic Wolf’s cloud to the customer environment via the network appliance platform.

At Uber, millions of riders trust us to get them where they need to go, every day. But what makes a great ride experience? What frustrates riders, what builds their trust, and what makes them choose Uber again and again?  
  
We are looking for someone who is **obsessed with understanding consumers** — someone who is endlessly curious about what riders think, feel and experience, and passionate about turning those insights into meaningful change.  
  
In this role, you will be the **champion of the rider's voice within Uber**, ensuring that consumer needs, expectations and pain points are at the heart of how we build products, design experiences and make business decisions.  
  
You will shape Uber's Rider Experience strategy across India & South Asia, working closely with Product, Operations, Marketing and Marketplace teams to make Uber the most trusted and preferred mobility platform.  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep consumer understanding with strategic thinking and real business impact — moving beyond understanding what riders want to actually making it happen.  

* **Drive Consumer Insights & Problem Solving:** Bring structure to ambiguous consumer problems, triangulating quantitative data, qualitative research and field insights to uncover root causes, size opportunities and drive actionable recommendations.

* **Embed Consumer Obsession Across Uber:** Bring compelling consumer insights and data-backed recommendations into leadership discussions, challenge assumptions and mobilize teams to act on what matters most to riders.

  
**What You'll Need**

* **Analytical rigor & structured problem solving:** Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems, synthesize complex datasets and marry quantitative evidence with qualitative insights.

* **Strong ownership & execution:** Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving cross-functional initiatives and moving from problem identification to implementation.

jobs.title: Product Manager (RASP)
jobs.description:
**About Bureau**

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

**Why Bureau?**

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

**About the Role: Product Manager - RASP**

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

* Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
* Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
* Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
* Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
* Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
* Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
* Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
* Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
* Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
* Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
* Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
* Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must have**

* 4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
* Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
* Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
* A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
* Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

**Good to have**

* Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
* Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
* An engineering or security research background.

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Delhivery moves millions of shipments a day across one of the most complex physical networks: pickups, line-haul, sorting, last-mile, returns, and cross-border. Every one of those steps generates data, decisions, and money on the table. We believe the next decade of logistics will be won by whoever applies AI most intelligently to the physical world.

We are building a team of Product Managers who will reimagine logistics with an Agentic first approach. You won't be bolting a chatbot on a dashboard. You will own problems where a better model or a smarter agent changes unit economics, customer experience, or network reliability at national scale.

.
**What You’ll Do**

* **Find the right problems.**
  Spend time in hubs, with riders, ops leaders, and merchants. Translate messy operational pain into opportunities for creating a seamless flow that scales.
* **Own outcomes, not outputs.**
  Define success metrics tied to cost per shipment, delivery success, NPS, or revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
* **Ship AI products that real operators use.**
  Design human-in-the-loop workflows, fallbacks, and feedback loops so models earn trust on the ground and keep improving after launch.
* **Drive adoption across the org.**
  Work with Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to embed AI into how teams actually work.
* **Partner deeply with data science and engineering.**
  Shape problem formulation, data requirements, evaluation methodology, and model-versus-rules trade-offs. Understand precision/recall, drift, latency, and cost well enough to challenge and be challenged.
* **Run rigorous experimentation.**
  A/B tests, shadow deployments, and phased rollouts across geographies and hubs, with clear go/no-go criteria.
* **Stay at the frontier.**
  Evaluate new LLM, agentic, and vision capabilities, and decide pragmatically what to build, buy, or fine-tune.

**The kind of problems you could own**

* **Network intelligence:**
  demand forecasting, capacity planning, dynamic routing, and ETA prediction across the network
* **Last-mile optimization:**
  address intelligence and geocoding, delivery-attempt prediction, route and slot optimization, rider productivity
* **Computer vision on the ground:**
  shipment damage detection, automated weighing and dimensioning, sort-center throughput, proof-of-delivery verification
* **Generative AI and agents:**
  autonomous customer support, ops copilots for hub managers, document and invoice automation, internal knowledge assistants
* **Risk and trust:**
  fraud, RTO (return-to-origin) prediction, NDR resolution, and merchant risk scoring
* **Pricing and commercial intelligence:**
  dynamic pricing, serviceability, and yield optimization

You will be matched to problem statements based on impact, your strengths, and the stage of each problem. Expect to work across more than one.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience**

* 2–5 years in product management, ideally with at least 1–2 years shipping ML or AI-driven products (or a strong data science, ML engineering, or analytics background that you have transitioned into product)
* A track record of taking a product from ambiguous problem to measurable business impact
* Strong academic grounding; engineering degree from a top-tier institution preferred, MBA a plus but not required

**Skills**

* Working fluency in ML concepts: model evaluation, training data quality, feedback loops, and the practical differences between classical ML, deep learning, and LLM-based systems
* Hands-on comfort with data: SQL is a must, Python or notebooks a plus. You pull your own numbers.
* Experience with, or sharp point of view on, GenAI product design: prompt and eval design, RAG, agents, guardrails, and cost/latency trade-offs
* Excellent structured thinking and the ability to communicate with engineers, data scientists, and frontline ops leaders equally well
* Bias to action, ownership, and comfort operating in complex, high-volume, real-world environments

**Pedigree signals we value**

* Prior experience at product-led or AI-forward companies (marketplaces, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, SaaS, or AI-native startups)
* Evidence of impact: shipped models or AI features with quantifiable results, side projects, or published work
* Curiosity about the physical world: supply chains, operations, and hardware-meets-software problems

jobs.description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as analytics, data engineering, business and product management, etc to solve complex problems for the organization.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the domain and technology landscape deeply through landscape analysis, user interviews/research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.

* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Vision: Ability to set forward looking vision and roadmap for the charter aligned with company’s goals
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (analytics, engineering, business, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company with experience in data, analytics, engineering etc.

* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology and data landscape, and comfort with product management processes such as writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**What We Need**

* Data-native PM — you think in funnels, cohorts, and experiments before PRDs. You write SQL, build dashboards, and catch insights nobody asked you to find.
* Hands-on with AI agents — you've actually built something with LLMs, not just read about them. Prompt engineering is table stakes.
* Entrepreneur DNA — you've tried building something of your own (a startup, a side project, a 0→1 product) or you're a seasoned Growth PM who's operated across the full acquisition-to-revenue loop.
* Business-grade judgment — you hold your own in revenue conversations, understand unit economics, and translate growth levers into P&L impact.

**This is not a feature PM role.**
There's no stable roadmap someone hands you. You define problems, find levers, ship fast, and measure what matters.
  
  
**What You'll Do -**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* You are obsessed with users but grounded in business and data.
* You have 6+ years of experience in product management with at least 2 years focused on growth or PLG initiatives.
* You're hands-on, hungry, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
* You have a strong command over product analytics and experimentation frameworks.
* You understand technology deeply enough to work well with engineers, but your core superpower is thinking from a customer-first and business-first lens.
* You think in systems, love solving root problems, and approach prioritization through impact and effort.
* You’re structured in thinking, biased for action, and love taking ownership end-to-end.

****About Us****
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
****Job Description****
Product Manager - Job Description and Responsibilities
  
  
**Job Description**
Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.
  
  
The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.
  
  
We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of high-impact digital, AI, and automation products that improve processes across Client Services. This role will identify and prioritize opportunities, translate complex user and business needs into scalable product capabilities, guide technical solutioning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a skilled product manager with deep product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. They have experience building and scaling AI-enabled products from discovery and prototyping through production, adoption, and continuous improvement. * Lead the development of AI-enabled products in partnership with engineering and data science, including use-case selection, rapid prototyping, data and model readiness, evaluation criteria, human oversight, privacy and security controls, production deployment, observability, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Shape and deliver incident-management platform capabilities and workflow solutions that improve detection, intake, triage, escalation, collaboration, resolution, communications, reporting, and post-incident learning across Client Services.
* Communicate product strategy, investment rationale, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and performance insights to senior stakeholders and leadership, escalating to executive sponsors as needed.

**Qualifications**

5 or more years of relevant product management experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 3 or more years with an Advanced Degree (e.g., MBA, MS), including end-to-end ownership of complex digital, platform, automation, or AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and optimization.

jobs.description:
**Your Opportunity**

At GSK, the Chief Patient Officer (CPO) organization is one of three strategic pillars of the company – the independent medical and scientific partner to R&D and Commercial. Medical’s vision is to embed the patient voice and external insights into product strategy and evidence generation, shape medical practice through trusted, non-promotional scientific engagement, and deliver measurable health impact for patients at scale.

This is your chance to build the enterprise AI Context Layer for GSK Medical – the trusted, connected foundation that turns data and content from across the medical planning framework into measurable value. As Associate Director Product Owner, Medical Data Products, you will own the data products and context layer spanning Data Generation, Scientific Communications, Medical Information, Publications and Channel Engagement, including Medical Science Liaison (MSL) interactions, non-personal channels, advisory boards and other external engagement activities.

You will join the Medical Cx and Data team – responsible for product management across Medical Cx and measurement, medical analytics and medical content – as a strategic business leader enabled by technology: accountable for outcomes, not just delivery, and the go-to leader and trusted advisor for medical data and AI context.

Working alongside the Medical Measurement Product Owner, Medical Digital & Tech Engineering and Architecture, and partners across Medical Affairs, Enterprise Data & AI, Commercial and Digital & Tech, you will act as the voice of the customer for Global Medical Teams (GMTs) and Local Operating Companies (LOCs) – co-creating data-driven products that reduce time-to-insight, demonstrate the impact of external engagement and help teams act with confidence. Your work will build the trusted, connected and compliant data foundation that powers analytics, GenAI and agentic solutions.

We are looking for a senior data product leader with 8 to 10+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise cloud data platforms, with expertise in data modelling, lakehouse architecture, data integration and governance. You have experience transforming varied source data into canonical (standardized) data models and building governed, reusable data products, with Azure/Databricks experience and a practical understanding of data enrichment and AI/machine learning (ML) data architectures.

**About CODE Orange**

You’ll build your data products on GSK’s CODE Orange Platform, our enterprise data and analytics platform hosted on Microsoft Azure and GCP. As the core data ecosystem for every GSK business unit and function, it delivers clean, connected data through a unified, trusted, reusable and compliant data lifecycle. Shared standards for governance, role-based access, zero-trust security and auditing protect sensitive data while enabling safe reuse of data across GSK.

**What You Will Do**

**Set an outcome-focused vision**

* Own the strategy, roadmap and value-based backlog for the Medical AI Context Layer and the data generation, content and channel data products that feed it – co-created with the business, sequenced across the medical planning framework and aligned to GSK’s strategic priorities.

**Build the enterprise Medical AI Context Layer**

* Define and deliver a governed semantic layer – shared medical data ontology, business glossary, knowledge graph and metadata – that links medical objectives, tactics, evidence, content, engagement and outcomes across the medical planning framework, so analytics, GenAI and agentic solutions draw on one trusted, consistent source of medical context.

**Drive business value**

* Drive adoption of medical data products and the AI Context Layer to reduce time-to-insight for Global Medical Teams (GMTs) and Local Operating Companies (LOCs), measure the ROI of content and engagement, and increase reuse of trusted context across GenAI and agentic use cases.

**Champion the customer**

* Act as the voice of GMTs and LOCs through continuous user research, turning their pain points into an actionable, user-centric backlog.

**Define, validate and own success**

* Set success metrics up front, prove value through proofs of value (POVs) before scaling, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as adoption, data quality and user satisfaction.

**Evangelize and lead change**

* Lead change management, demos and training to drive enterprise-wide adoption and data literacy.

**Own architecture and canonical models**

* Oversee data ingestion end-to-end and the target canonical/conformed data model connecting engagement data to GSK Medical data – balancing technical debt against feature delivery.

**Establish governance by design**

* Oversee the data lake governance and framework – access models, schemas, classification, lineage, metadata, quality and storage standards aligned to CODE Orange – partnering with platform, security and data-owner teams and building GxP (regulated good-practice quality standards) and data protection in from the start.

**Hold partners to outcomes**

* Align platforms, engineering teams and vendors around shared outcomes, connecting data across functions and managing dependencies through to completion.

**Work AI-first**

* Use approved AI tools to accelerate discovery and backlog trade-offs – keeping AI in support of decisions, not replacing them.

**Future-proof the ecosystem**

* Ensure data assets are structured, scalable and of high enough quality to power GenAI, predictive analytics and agentic workflows.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Business Data Analyst

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Experience:**
8+ Years

**About the role:**

Latinum is looking for an experienced Business Data Analyst for a client to drive end-to-end delivery of enterprise data, analytics, and reporting initiatives.

The role involves partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements, analyse business processes and datasets, assess solution feasibility, and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications. You will work closely with Data Engineering and BI teams to deliver scalable data solutions on Azure, covering the complete SDLC from requirement gathering to deployment and production support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage with business stakeholders across multiple domains to gather, analyse, challenge, and document business requirements through workshops and discovery sessions.
* Perform business process analysis, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), and gap analysis to validate business rules, identify data quality issues, and define future-state solutions.
* Assess functional and technical feasibility, implementation approaches, dependencies, risks, and solution options.
* Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, process flows, business rules, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and project documentation.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering and BI teams.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers throughout the SDLC to clarify requirements, track implementation, resolve functional issues, and ensure successful delivery.
* Write and optimise SQL queries on Azure Synapse and Salesforce staging data for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
* Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, dashboards, reports, and DAX measures for enterprise reporting and KPI tracking.
* Define and validate requirements for data integrations, reporting, automation, and data quality improvements.
* Coordinate SIT and UAT, manage defects, validate acceptance criteria, and obtain stakeholder sign-off.
* Support production deployments and post-production hypercare, coordinating issue resolution between business and technical teams.
* Maintain KPI definitions, data dictionaries, governance artefacts, and reporting standards while managing multiple initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Enterprise Reporting within large or complex organisations.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end requirements and delivery across discovery, analysis, documentation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong expertise in business process analysis, EDA, gap analysis, and technical feasibility assessments.
* Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in Azure Synapse Analytics or equivalent MPP/cloud data warehouse platforms.
* Advanced Power BI skills, including semantic modelling, DAX, dashboard development, and enterprise reporting.
* Good understanding of relational databases, ETL/ELT concepts, data modelling, source-to-target mappings, and data governance.
* Experience translating business requirements into functional and technical specifications for Data Engineering teams.
* Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with Data Engineering teams.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.
* Strong documentation skills, including BRDs, FRDs, process flows, and testing artefacts.
* Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Real Estate industry experience is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ideal Candidate: A strong Business Data Analyst who combines business requirements ownership, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, Azure data platform exposure, and end-to-end SDLC delivery experience.

As an Agile Business Analyst (AI Native), you will own and drive the metrics that matter for our engineering teams: building dashboards and presentations, adding commentary and context, observing and reporting trends, and recommending new metrics as our ways of working evolve with AI and agentic software development. You will also gather, organize, analyze, and present business information to support better decisions across Product Management and PTO workflows. You will use business intelligence, process automation tools, SQL, Python, R, ETL pipelines, REST APIs, DOMO, Power Platform, RPA, and approved AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, data clarity, process documentation, and UAT quality.
  
  
AI gives you leverage. You bring judgment. You remain accountable for validating outputs, protecting sensitive information, and delivering analysis that is accurate, practical, and aligned to business needs.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Initiate, plan, and design business processes and make recommendations to improve and support business activities.
* Leverage business process automation tools to develop and maintain business process automation.

* Build and maintain engineering metrics and leadership dashboards in DOMO to enable decision-making.
* Prepare recurring metrics presentations for engineering and product leadership, adding commentary and color on performance, trends, and outliers.
* Monitor engineering metrics such as delivery flow, cycle time, throughput, quality, and predictability, and report meaningful trends and risks.
* Propose new metrics, and retire low-value ones, as teams adopt AI-assisted and agentic development practices.
* Support and troubleshoot REST API integrations that feed metrics data, including authentication, pagination, rate limits, and failed refreshes.
* Gather information from end users and document business processes.
* Review PTO compliance to business processes and work with teams to improve compliance as appropriate.
* Assist on special projects by reporting, analyzing, and making recommendations to the team.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing sessions to ensure deliverables meet business needs.
* Analyze large quantities of data to support system integrity.

* Recommend new or refined metrics as engineering ways of working evolve with AI-assisted and agentic software development.
* Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate documentation, analysis, testing, and communication.
* Support automation opportunities through practical assessment, design support, and validation.
* Ensure UAT, data review, and process recommendations are grounded in evidence.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Computer or Business Informatics related field.
* Two (2)+ years of related experience.
* Experience with AWS QuickSight or other BI reporting tools such as DOMO.

**Skills, Knowledge And Abilities**

* Business analysis, process documentation, BI reporting, and dashboard development capability.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel.
* Proficiency in SQL and ability to develop and manage ETL data pipelines.
* Working proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis and automation.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, with the ability to support and troubleshoot API-based data integrations.
* Hands-on experience supporting DOMO, including datasets, DataFlows, connectors, and dashboards.
* Solid understanding of software development and agile practices, and how engineering teams measure delivery.
* Ability to turn data into clear narrative commentary and presentations for leadership.
* Ability to design and build Power Platform or RPA automations.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks while effectively focusing on priority issues.
* Ability to work as a member of an agile team.
* Written and verbal communication skills.
* Responsible use of approved AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, quality, and clarity.
* Work on problems of moderate scope that are often varied and routine.
